rag_probe.answer: ФНС публикует описание открытых данных реестра получателей поддержки МСП, но не содержит персональные данные в демонстрацию.
rag_probe.runtime: Docker RAG with native-host Ollama; full CPU Docker/Selectel runtime not verified

limits: Functional inference used Docker RAG with native-host Ollama; it is not a CPU benchmark for Selectel.
Full self-contained Qwen Docker stack and live Selectel deployment were not exercised on the target 8-vCPU/16-GB VM.
Current desktop Docker has about 4 GB RAM; OCR configuration and running OCR were preserved.
